title: achillea ptarmica subsp. ptarmicifolia
intro: Achillea ptarmica subsp. ptarmicifolia, commonly known as Sneezewort or Yarrow White, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include relief from inflammation, pain, and digestive issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Sneezewort White include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
